## The corrected re-run landed — both halves confirmed end to end, and the wrong-cwd sweep was hiding a live RED gate

Same seat, 2026-09-19T10:08Z. The sweep was re-run with `cwd = /home/user/objectui` (`origin` =
`objectstack-ai/objectui`, `git ls-files` = 7945) against the same board, same `PM_SWEEP_REPO`, same
script. Everything below is a difference between two runs whose only variable is the working
directory.

| reading | cwd `/home/user/objectstack` | cwd `/home/user/objectui` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| H17 oracle — 「tracked file(s) in the oracle」 | **8888** | **7945** |
| H57 | **UNRESOLVED, read nothing** | **10 workflow(s) declare a schedule; 8 judged, 0 UNJUDGED** |
| H57 rows filed | **0** | **1** |
| rows in file vs the sweep's own footer | 500 = 500 | 502 = 502 |

⇒ 8888 is objectstack's tracked-file count and 7945 is objectui's, exactly as the card predicted.
⭐ Both runs reconcile against their own footer, so ⛔ neither is a broken run — the wrong-cwd one is
internally consistent and externally wrong, which is the whole hazard.

### ⭐ What the blind row was hiding

The single H57 row the corrected run produced is not cosmetic:

> `objectstack-ai/objectui` · `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` — the latest run whose
> `event` is `schedule` … concluded `failure` rather than `success`. Declared `0 */6 * * *` … ⇒ RED.

Followed up and filed as **objectstack-ai/objectui#10010**: that lane has failed **5 consecutive
scheduled fires over ~24h** (and ~17 in a row the week before), stopping at 「Validate the
post-version tree」, with publish and the version-PR refresh skipped each time — while **every `push`
fire of the same workflow in the same window is green**, so no push-driven signal shows it. 1764
pending changesets sit behind it.

⇒ this is precisely the shape H57's own prose claims for itself — 「a workflow that dies cannot report
its own death」 — and the cwd defect meant the one reader built to catch it was reading another repo's
checkout instead. ⛔ Three sweeps by this seat today reported on the objectui board with that row
silent.

### Row-level diff, for whoever takes this

Rows present in the corrected run and absent from the wrong-cwd one: `H57 #35425956496`,
`H16 #5400`, `H16 #8941`, `H44 #9899`, `H67 #8281`. ⚠️ Only the H57 one is explained by the cwd
defect with certainty; the other four may simply be a later read of a moving board, and this seat
⛔ does not claim otherwise. The three rows that DISAPPEARED — `H20 #9925`, `H50 #9950`,
`H52 #9925` — are the three this seat remediated between the two runs, which is the expected
direction and a small check that the two files are comparable at all.
